On a very hot night, when it must have been so hard to keep the gut strings in tune, a Wigmore Hall concert with the always wondrous Lea Desandre, Thomas Dunford and the Jupiter Ensemble singing and playing Handel. 

[The direct link to the Wigmore site is here](https://www.wigmore-hall.org.uk/whats-on/202606241930), and the page also links to the programme details. If you haven't done so before, you may need to register for free to see the video. It is a sheer delight.
